title: Boids
description: A murmuration of thousands, running on nothing but Reynolds' three rules — separation, alignment, cohesion. Your finger is a predator they scatter and split around, or an attractor they wind into a glowing vortex. Fear spreads bird to bird, so one scare travels outward as a visible wave long after you let go. Colour is the flock's own heading, so you can watch alignment happen.
